## Daybreak Neighborhoods

- [Daybreak Neighborhood Guides](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods): Guides to every Daybreak village, covering price ranges, home types, HOA structure, build years, and who each village fits best.
- [Founders Park Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/founders-park-village): Founders Park Village is Daybreak's original 2004 neighborhood in South Jordan, UT. Craftsman and Victorian resale homes, $350K–$1.1M+, walkable to SoDa Row and TRAX.
- [Eastlake Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/eastlake-village): Eastlake Village sits on Oquirrh Lake's eastern shore in Daybreak, South Jordan. Estate homes $500K–$1.2M+, Promenade Park pool, tennis, and beach access.
- [North Shore Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/north-shore-village): North Shore Village is Daybreak's most affordable lakeside neighborhood in South Jordan, UT. Townhomes and homes $380K–$750K, walkable to Harmons and Brookside Park.
- [Lake Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/lake-village): Lake Village offers waterfront and water-view homes on Oquirrh Lake's western shore in Daybreak, South Jordan. $450K–$1.2M+, Waterside Club boathouse access.
- [Creekside Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/creekside-village): Creekside Village in Daybreak, South Jordan centers on 15-acre Brookside Park. Resale homes $430K–$800K from multiple builders, with TRAX North Station nearby.
- [Garden Park](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/garden-park): Garden Park is Utah's largest 55+ active adult community, in Daybreak, South Jordan. Ivory Homes condos to estates, $350K–$900K+, private 14,000 sq ft clubhouse.
- [SoDa Row](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/soda-row): SoDa Row is Daybreak's walkable urban core in South Jordan, UT. Modern townhomes and condos $400K–$700K, steps from dining, shops, and the Oquirrh Lake Beach Club.
- [South Station Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/south-station-village): South Station Village is Daybreak's transit-oriented townhome neighborhood in South Jordan. $400K–$650K, steps from TRAX and the Salt Lake Bees ballpark.
- [Highland Park Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/highland-park-village): Highland Park Village is Daybreak's first Upper Village in South Jordan, UT. Homes $475K–$900K with The Loop bike highway, The Hub pool, and Trail Crossing shopping.
- [Heights Park Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/heights-park-village): Heights Park Village offers elevated Oquirrh Lake and Wasatch views in Daybreak, South Jordan. Homes and twin homes $425K–$850K with The Loop trail access.
- [SpringHouse Village](https://movetodaybreak.com/service-areas/daybreak/neighborhoods/springhouse-village): SpringHouse Village is Daybreak's 55+ community west of Bangerter in South Jordan, UT. OakwoodLife homes $400K–$700K+, private clubhouse, pool, and fitness center.
